## Claim a brewery

Add `data/claims/<slug>.json` and open a **pull request**. See [data/README.md](../../data/README.md). Do not file an issue.

The website form at https://dutch.beer/en/contribute?kind=claim prefills the file. Use the brewery’s official website so a reviewer can check the domain.

Do not invent a cover image, logo, description, or social account.
